full_prompt_en: A square, stylized oil painting shows four solemn adults and a yellow dog arranged before a dark interior doorway. Warm ocher walls fill the upper corners, and a rectangular wooden frame rises from just behind the central figure to the top edge. Within it, the door recess is almost black on the left and muted brown on the right. At the far left stands a woman with a rounded brown hair shape and long pale face. She wears a simple black garment over a pale blouse, and her hands meet near the bottom edge around the handle of a small bag. The tall man in the center faces directly forward beneath the doorway frame. He has short dark hair, very elongated pale features, small wide eyes, and a straight thin mouth. A black suit forms one unbroken dark shape from shoulders to the cropped lower edge, interrupted by a white shirt front and narrow black tie. On the right side, an older woman with gray hair pulled into a low bun stands in profile, facing left toward him. Her brown textured dress or coat covers the torso, while one pale hand extends forward near the bottom. Behind her, an older bald man in a dark suit faces left; the rim of his glasses and his prominent nose stand out against the ocher wall. At the lower left, a lean mustard-yellow dog with a black collar lifts its head toward the group, its body partly cropped by the frame. A brown chair back is visible behind the older woman at the lower right. The figures have simplified anatomy and narrow, deliberately stiff postures. Their faces are modeled in flat cream and olive-ochre planes, with tiny eyes and restrained marks for mouths. Fine canvas-like grain appears over the walls and garments, while thin dark outlines sharpen the door trim, dog, and pale facial contours. Light is even and subdued, as though entering from the room in front of the group; the pale faces and dog are brightest against the dark clothes and recess. Soft, nearly absent cast shadows keep the space shallow. The overall composition is rigidly balanced and quietly strange, using repeated vertical silhouettes, mustard and umber surfaces, and emotionally reserved expressions.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形的风格化油画呈现四位神情肃穆的成年人和一只黄狗，排列在昏暗的室内门前。暖赭色墙面填满上方两个角，一道矩形木门框从中央人物身后一直升到上边缘。框内门洞左侧近黑，右侧是灰暗褐色。最左侧站着一名女子，棕色头发形成圆团，脸部浅而修长。她在浅色上衣外穿简洁黑衣，双手在下边缘附近合握一个小包的把手。中央高个男子在门框下正面站立，短深发、极修长的浅色面部、小而睁大的眼睛和细直的嘴。他的黑西装从肩膀到被裁去的下边缘连成一块深色形体，只被白衬衫前襟与窄黑领带打断。右侧，一名灰发在脑后挽成低髻的年长女子向左侧身，看向他。带肌理的棕色裙装或外套覆盖躯干，一只浅色手在下方伸向前面。她身后，一名穿深色西装的年长秃顶男子也朝左；眼镜边缘和突出的鼻子在赭色墙前十分显眼。左下方，一只戴黑项圈的瘦长芥末黄狗抬头朝向人群，身体部分被画框截断。右下方，年长女子身后露出一截棕色椅背。人物解剖经过简化，姿态狭长且刻意僵直。脸部用平坦的奶油色与橄榄赭色色面塑造，眼睛很小，嘴巴只留克制的记号。墙面与衣服上覆盖细微画布颗粒，纤细深线则让门框、狗和浅色脸部轮廓更清晰。光均匀而低调，仿佛从人物前方的房间照来；浅色脸和狗在深色衣服与门洞前最亮。柔弱且几乎不见的投影让空间保持浅平。整体构图严格均衡又安静古怪，用反复出现的竖向剪影、芥末黄与赭褐表面、情绪收敛的表情构成画面。
style_prompt_en: The stylized painting organizes forms into long, quiet vertical silhouettes and flat planes of mustard, ocher, umber, cream, and near-black. Proportions are intentionally stretched and simplified, while small precise marks carry expressions or functional detail. Dark garments and recesses read as broad continuous shapes against warmer, slightly textured grounds. Thin outlines clarify selected borders, but interior modeling stays restrained and often nearly flat. A fine canvas-like grain softens the large color fields without filling them with decoration. Lighting is subdued and frontal enough to make pale planes legible, with very little dramatic cast shadow; value contrast does most of the work. Rectangular framing and upright repetition create a formal, still rhythm. The overall effect is dry, observational, and subtly uncanny, with emotional distance held inside an orderly composition.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格化绘画将形体组织成长而安静的竖向剪影，以及芥末黄、赭黄、深褐、奶油白和近黑色的平坦色面。比例被有意拉长并简化，少量准确的记号承载神情或功能细节。深色块在较暖、略有肌理的底面前读作宽阔连续的形状。细线界定选定边缘，内部塑形却克制，往往近乎平坦。细微画布颗粒使大色面柔和，却没有填满装饰。光低调且较为正面，足以让浅色平面可辨，几乎没有戏剧性的投影；视觉主要依靠明度对比。矩形框架与直立形体的重复营造正式而静止的节奏。整体效果干涩、冷静且隐隐古怪，情绪距离被控制在整齐的构图内。
theme_en: A solemn family group and a yellow dog before a dark doorway
theme_zh: 深色门前神情肃穆的一家人与黄狗
name: John Brack
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
